_comment: Diagnostic Scanner Recipe - Reveals enemy information
_educational_note: Simulates OBD-II diagnostic scanning where queries are sent to ECU modules to retrieve status information and DTCs.
name: Active Diagnostic Scan
description: Sends ECU query signals to probe enemy systems, revealing their health, status, and vulnerabilities.

inputs._comment: Query signals to interrogate enemy systems
Scanner pulse to broadcast the query

properties._note: Lasts 10 turns, reveals info on up to 5 enemies

on_craft.text: Diagnostic scan complete. Enemy systems analyzed.
